map.膜种选型：实测热收缩率并与 PE/POF/PVC 的标称区间对照，判断该膜是否适: Film grade selection: measure the actual heat shrink rate and compare it with the nominal ranges of PE, POF and PVC to judge whether the film suits the product shape and appearance requirements.

map.算例：原始尺寸 400 mm、热收缩后 240 mm: Worked example: original size 400 mm, 240 mm after heat shrinking
map.热收缩率 =（400 − 240）÷ 400 × 100% = 40.00%；收: Heat shrink rate = (400 - 240) / 400 x 100% = 40.00%; post-shrink proportion = 240 / 400 x 100% = 60.00%; recommended cut film width = 400 x 1.06 = 424.00 mm.
map.热收缩率与收缩后占比是什么关系？: What is the relation between shrink rate and post-shrink proportion?
map.两者互补：收缩率 + 收缩后占比 = 100%。收缩率越高说明膜的收缩张力越大，: They are complementary: shrink rate + post-shrink proportion = 100%. A higher shrink rate means more shrink tension and a tighter wrap, but it also raises the risk of over-shrinking (deformation, tearing).
map.6% 是常见工艺余量，用于吸收收缩不均与封口压边损耗；产品形状复杂或膜收缩率偏差: 6% is a common process allowance that absorbs uneven shrinking and the loss from seal overlap; for complex product shapes or films with a large shrink-rate deviation, raise it to 8%-10%.
